sections.title: Diluted earnings per share by quarter
sections.callout: Q4 FY2025: diluted EPS of $1.69, up from $1.34 a year earlier.

footnotes: Banks have no cost of sales; the flow chart shows revenue (net interest income + noninterest income) going to noninterest expense and the provision for credit losses, leaving pre-tax income. From pre-tax income to net income to common: after income tax and $915K attributable to noncontrolling interests, $691K of preferred dividends & other. Efficiency ratio = noninterest expense ÷ revenue (lower is better).
Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Sep 30, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Diluted EPS by quarter as reported in the 10-Qs; fourth quarters are calculated (net income ÷ estimated diluted shares) because EPS does not add across quarters.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue (net interest income plus noninterest income) rose 5.3% to $840M in fiscal 2025 (ended Sep 30, 2025). Net interest income rose 2.8% to $512M and noninterest income rose 9.5% to $328M; noninterest expense rose 7.6%, and the provision for credit losses was $56.8M, versus $58.1M.
Net income to common rose 2.0% to $185M, or $7.87 per diluted share, and the efficiency ratio was 66.7% versus 65.3%. Pathward returned $4.7M through dividends.
highlights: Net income to common rose 2.0% to $185M.
watch: Net interest income depends on interest rates.
